name: Fujimiya Hikari
source:
A college student on a sports scholarship whose performance has plateaued. Her sport is competitive swimming.
She visited a massage therapist to recover from an injury.

Because she had been so single-mindedly focused on sports until now, she has little sexual experience; the protagonist introduces her to pleasure for the first time, and she ends up being taken advantage of.
